name: Monopoly Spider-Man — Green Goblin
theme: A team of Spider-Heroes against a villain who plays himself
tagline: The Green Goblin moves with nobody holding him.
summary: Each player takes a Spider-Hero with their own power. Capture the super-villains, deploy Spider-Bots to protect the city, and dodge the Green Goblin — an autonomous pawn that moves every turn and drops Pumpkin Bombs. The game ends when every villain is captured, or only one hero is left.

cards.bugle-01: Front-page scoop: collect $100 for selling exclusive photos to J. Jonah Jameson.
cards.bugle-02: Pumpkin Bomb alert: the Green Goblin strikes. A bomb lands on the nearest unprotected property.
cards.bugle-03: Heroic defusal: remove a Pumpkin Bomb from the board and collect a $50 city reward.
cards.bugle-04: Emergency web-line: advance directly to GO. Collect $200.
cards.bugle-05: Avengers assist: the next rent charged to you is cancelled.
cards.bugle-06: Night patrol: advance to the next super-villain still at large.
cards.bugle-07: Symbiote alert: go to Venom or to Carnage. If you pass GO, collect $200.
cards.bugle-08: Arrest warrant from Jameson: go directly to The Vault. Do not pass GO, do not collect $200.
cards.bugle-09: Vault release pass. This card may be kept until used or sold.
cards.bugle-10: Goblin air raid: the Green Goblin advances 3 spaces and strikes where he lands.
cards.bugle-11: Parker science scholarship: collect $50 from Horizon Labs.
cards.bugle-12: Spider-Bot maintenance: pay the bank $25 for every Spider-Bot you have deployed.
cards.bugle-13: Late pizza delivery: your double life makes you late. Pay a $20 fine.
cards.bugle-14: Hacked surveillance: you read the next dispatch straight away.
cards.bugle-15: Stealth infiltration: steal $50 from the player holding the most cash.
cards.bugle-16: High-flying rescue: every other player pays you $10.
cards.bugle-17: Oscorp grid failure: go to the nearest service. Throw the dice and pay ten times the amount thrown.
cards.bugle-18: Sinister Six ambush: the street is wrecked. Pay $50 in collateral damage.
cards.bugle-19: Spider-Cycle chase: advance to the Spider-Cycle. If you pass GO, collect $200.
cards.bugle-20: Web-Glider flight: advance to the Web-Glider. If you pass GO, collect $200.
cards.bugle-21: Photo blackmail: the wealthiest player goes back 2 spaces.
cards.bugle-22: Web-Warriors rally: deploy one Spider-Bot free of charge on one of your properties.
cards.bugle-23: Great city clean-up: remove up to 2 Pumpkin Bombs from the board.
cards.bugle-24: Aunt May's support: collect $100 of family savings for your gear.
